h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Tadipatri

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Tadipatri

items.pText: Tadipatri, on the Penna river in Anantapur district, is known for its stone polishing works, and that stone often ends up paving the town's school courtyards and society compounds. Polished stone looks neat, but it is a hard and slippery surface for a child to fall on. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment for schools, colonies and parks in Tadipatri at our factory in Vasai East, about 740 km away.

This is the dry, hot Rayalaseema region, with low rainfall and long summers that run well into May. The equipment travels by road, and our installation team or a dealer in south India fixes it on site, self-standing or grouted. Send us photos of the ground as it is today, paved or bare, with its length and width. We will plan the equipment and the surface together on one layout drawing.

props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: What to lay under the equipment on a paved site

c: A slide or swing should never sit directly on granite, stone slabs or concrete. Keep the safe play area free of hard paving and lay rubber flooring there instead, which we supply along with the equipment. Rubber flooring is usually laid over a level concrete base, so on an existing courtyard you may only need to repair the base, not break it up.

items.a: Yes, but the area children can fall on should be covered with an impact-absorbing surface such as rubber flooring. We mark this safe play area on the layout drawing so you know exactly how much to cover.

items.q: Do you supply rubber flooring with the equipment?
